newsitem.title: THAILAND: Thai baht down, interbank rate lower late.
newsitem.headline: Thai baht down, interbank rate lower late.

text.p: The Thai baht weakened against the dollar in late active trade on Friday on dollar short covering ahead of the weekend, dealers said.
The baht was traded at 25.895/25.900 to the dollar near close compared with 25.885/25.890 in the morning, dealers said.
"The market was active with more dollar buying than selling. Some players buy the dollar to cover their positions ahead of the weekend," said one dealer at a U.S. bank.
The Bank of Thailand fixed the mid-rate at 25.89 per dollar against 25.91 on Thursday.
The overnight interbank rate fell to 9.00-9.50 percent late from 10.00 in the morning on ample liquidity, dealers said.

"Some major local banks attempted to maintain the interbank rate above 10 percent by quoting as high as 10.50 percent. But the liquidity remained high," said one money market dealer at a foreign bank.
The one-month baht/dollar swap premium was down to 10.00/11.00 satangs per dollar late from 11.50/12.50 in early trade, dealers said.
